name: AdLeader
tagline: Every inquiry, tied to the ad that brought it
taglineHebrew: מפרסום לליד, בלי לאבד אף פנייה
oneLiner: A production, Hebrew-RTL, multi-tenant SaaS that captures every inquiry from every channel (form, WhatsApp, email, tracking link, phone), attributes it automatically to the source and campaign that produced it, and turns advertising spend into a per-source profit-and-loss so a business owner can see the real return on each shekel.

architecture.tenancy: Business-scoped multi-tenant: every entity under businesses/{businessId}; authorization derived from session, never client input

highlights: Automatic attribution: every inquiry from every channel is bound to the source and campaign that produced it, at capture time, with no manual work
Race-safe lead identity resolution: a single Firestore transaction dedupes returning inquiries across normalized phone/email via a leadKeys index, preserving first-touch while advancing last-touch
Per-source and per-campaign profit-and-loss (leads, deals, expenses) so the owner sees real return on ad spend, not vanity clicks

Robust public lead webhook: parses JSON / urlencoded / multipart from arbitrary form builders, matches Hebrew and English field aliases, extracts the MAKOR tracking code, and never leaks lead existence
AES-256-GCM at rest for every third-party credential and webhook token; plaintext tokens never persisted in the clear

Defense-in-depth billing webhook: timing-safe signature verification, negative-status-first parsing, idempotency claim, and coupon-aware amount reconciliation so an underpaid/failed charge cannot activate a plan
Stateless-serverless-aware primitives: Firestore-backed rate limiter (fail-open) and idempotency store, plus a jobs collection drained by a cron with exponential backoff
Tenant isolation proven at two layers: Firestore security rules AND real App Router handlers run against the emulator
Full Hebrew RTL UI for non-technical owners: leads inbox, drag-and-drop follow-up pipeline, WhatsApp + email threads on each lead card, automations, and honest per-source reports
features: Dashboard: pipeline overview, where leads come from, money summary, attribution breakdown, recent inquiries
Leads inbox: every inquiry with its source, campaign, attribution method and status, estimated value
Follow-up pipeline (CRM): drag-and-drop kanban across stages, auto-saved and reflected in reports and automations
Campaigns: budget, spend, sources, leads and real return per shekel
Reports: per-source and per-campaign comparison by real return, with Hebrew insight text and green/yellow/red markers
Communications: WhatsApp and email conversations attached to each lead's card
Tracking links & forms: a smart link per advertising place that measures clicks and attributes every inquiry automatically
Integrations: WhatsApp (Green API), email (Gmail/SMTP), email-marketing providers, payments
Automations: notifications and follow-up tasks so no inquiry falls through the cracks
Admin console: users, invitations, coupons, costs, logs, support (platform operator)
engineeringDecisions: Model a tenant as a business and scope every entity under businesses/{businessId}; derive businessId from the verified session and build all paths from businessRef(), so no route trusts a client-supplied tenant id

Resolve lead identity inside a single Firestore transaction with a claimable leadKeys index, preserving first-touch and advancing last-touch, so dedup and attribution are race-safe under provider retries
Attribute at capture time from whatever the outside world sends, marking confirmed vs manual_required, so the source is never guessed after the fact
Encrypt all stored credentials with authenticated AES-256-GCM and store webhook tokens only as SHA-256 hash + encrypted copy
Build rate limiting, idempotency and deferred side effects on Firestore (no Redis), so the system is correct on stateless serverless with instant webhook responses
Prove tenant isolation with both rules-level and route-level emulator tests rather than asserting it
